newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to add reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Tuesday, economists said.

"The funds rate is likely to remain above target most of today due to the settlement of $30 billion cash management bills and the approach of period settlement day tomorrow. Although the Fed appears to have little technical add need remaining over the final two days of the period, it will probably enter the market to protest the high funds rate," said Marc Wanshel, economist at Morgan Guaranty Trust Co.
The current two-week maintenance period ends on Wednesday.
Wanshel expected the Fed to intervene with either a two-day, or more likely, an overnight system RP -- probably smaller than the $3.95 billion arranged on Monday.
Fed funds were trading at 5.63 percent, higher than the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
